statement: Useful computation matters more than raw scale. We study how to make AI systems more efficient, not just larger.
Claims should be tied to evidence. We focus on problems where progress can be demonstrated and measured.
Deployment constraints should shape research questions early. Real-world limits are not afterthoughts.
Research should be legible enough for others to build on. Clarity is not optional.
Small teams should be honest about scope. We would rather do fewer things well than many things poorly.
